title: Kafka Apartments | 3BR near Wenceslas square
description:
Set on the 3rd floor of a peaceful residential building on Vladislavova street, this apartment offers a rare combination in Prague 1: a genuinely tranquil setting just minutes on foot from everything that draws visitors to the city. Old Town Square, Charles Bridge, and the National Theatre are all under a 15-minute walk away.

The space
A central, quiet retreat in the heart of Prague's New Town

Set on the 3rd floor of a peaceful residential building on Vladislavova street, this apartment offers a rare combination in Prague 1: a genuinely tranquil setting just minutes on foot from everything that draws visitors to the city. Old Town Square, Charles Bridge, and the National Theatre are all under a 15-minute walk away.

About Heller Home
Heller Home s.r.o. is a privately owned company, passionately organized and known for outstanding, professional service. Every member of our team works to make your stay in our exclusive apartments a seamless one.

The apartment
Seductive and striking, this three-bedroom, 115 m² apartment sits in the heart of the prestigious New Town — tucked into a quiet residential building, yet only a stone's throw from Wenceslas Square and minutes from Old Town Square and Charles Bridge. The location is ideal for exploring everything Prague has to offer.

Reflecting the urban character of the right-bank neighborhood, the apartment is within walking distance of landmarks including Na Příkopě street, the National Museum, the National Theatre, and Republic Square.

The neighborhood
This part of the city is loved for its lively atmosphere — cafés, restaurants, bars, classic Czech pubs, excellent nightlife, and an impressive range of shops: bakery, grocery, fishmonger, butcher, greengrocer, and gourmet food shop. For high-end shopping, Pařížská street is a short walk away.

The experience
The apartment epitomizes discreet luxury. The quality of the facilities and furnishings is beyond comparison, and combined with a truly enviable location, the result is an awe-inspiring home designed to make your visit to Prague memorable.

Getting around
The area is easily explored on foot, and Prague's tram and metro network handles the rest with ease. The Lázarská tram stop and Národní třída metro station are right on your doorstep, connecting you effortlessly to the rest of the city.

Building note
The apartment is on the third floor of a building with a lift. Please note that this is a small lift, accommodating two people at a time.

Property layout:

3 bedrooms
2 bathrooms
Living room / dining area
Make-up room
Kitchen
2 separate guest toilets
Utility room
1 small terrace

Beds: 3 king-size beds, each with the option to split into single beds.

In-apartment highlights
WiFi, large Smart TV, Nespresso machine, hair dryers, washing machine, dryer, and ironing facilities. Hotel-grade mattresses, make-up mirror, and the option to split beds.

Complimentary
Nespresso pods; a range of teas (black, green, and a wide selection of flavored); sugar, salt, pepper, olive oil; shower gel and soap; washing machine and dishwasher capsules.

Address
Vladislavova, Prague 1

This apartment is not suitable for young groups.

Parties of any kind (stag, hen, bachelor, etc.) are strictly forbidden.
Hostesses and escort services are strictly forbidden.
The apartment is non-smoking.

We are not flexible on these points. Due to serious past issues with neighbors, we strictly enforce these conditions and will not accept such guests on arrival.
If you have any doubts, please contact us before booking.

title: Royal Residence Apartments in the Heart of Prague
description:
We would like to invite you in our Royal Residence Apartment in the heart of Prague which is within 5-10 min walking from Old Town Square, Charles Bridge and Wenceslas Square.

This modern apartment in unique style is perfectly suited for business trip, couples or families. Located in a luxury residence with 24/7 reception includes: fully equipped modern kitchen, modern bathroom and luxury equipped rooms with windows unit air-condition.

It will be our pleasure to be your host, you are welcome

The space
Royal Residence Apartment is located at the ground floor of fully new modern residence with 24/7 reception in the heart of Prague city center. With an area of 70 square meters includes:- cozy living room in unique style with modern sofa and comfortable double bed, unique royal bedroom with a luxury queen bed, modern bathroom with toilet and another separate toilet, modern fully equipped kitchen and a small delightful balcony. The apartment has portable windows unit air-condition. Excellent WI-FI internet connection. All in one - unique place with all amenities offering enjoyable stay in the most beautiful and famous part of the city

Guest access
Before the arrival of the guest the apartment will always be prepared and clean, all that is written and what you see on the pictures can be used for your comfortable stay

Other things to note
- Late check in - free of charge;

- City (toruist) tax - it is 50czk for each adult person per every night and will need to be paid separately on the arrival, it is not included in the totall accommodation price;

- Please note that only the accommodation price for 1 or 2 guests is same and it is the base price, but for each extra guest above then 2 the price is different, the totall price can always be seen before you book the apartment when you add the exact number of guests;

- Cleaning fee - free of charge (it is included in the price);

- We can arrange taxi transport from/to the airport - 800 czech crowns in one way or 1500 czech crowns in both ways (round trip) for one car, from/to the bus or train station - 350 czech crowns in one way for one car. With two cars transport from/to the airport will be 1600czk in one way or 3000czk for arrangment in both ways (round trip);

- We would be glad to recommend to our guests sightseeing tours, restaurants and the most famous places to visit in Prague;

- Key delivery upon arrival - on the reception, it is working every day 24 hours;

- We don't have luggage storrage as we have only few apartments in the building and the reception is totally different company, but they are providing luggage storrage service for a very fair amount (100czk);

- Please note that we are obligated by the law to register every guest to the foreign police, it is a self online registration which is going through our fully protected system. The following personal details are required from each guest:

- Name
- Surname
- Date of birth
- Passport number and from which country it is;
- Visa number (only for the guests who need visa for entering in EU);
- Permanent address of living (Country, city and street number);

title: Spacious 105 m² Apt • City Center by Station
description:
The apartment is located right in the centre of Prague, in one of the most attractive areas. Just a few minutes’ walk away, you will find the Main Station, Wenceslas Square, and other popular spots in the historic centre. In the immediate surroundings, you will find a wide selection of restaurants, cafés, and shops, so everything you need is right at your doorstep. Its excellent location makes it an ideal base for exploring Prague and enjoying pleasant evenings in the lively city centre.

The space
This spacious apartment offers a comfortable base for your stay in the centre of Prague and is a great choice for families and larger groups of friends. The layout includes four separate bedrooms, a living room with a loft with a low ceiling, a kitchen, and two bathrooms with toilets. One bathroom is equipped with a bathtub, while the other has a shower.

Each bedroom features a queen-size bed. The living room also includes a loft with a low ceiling and an additional sleeping space. If needed, the sofa can also be unfolded, allowing the apartment to accommodate up to 12 guests. The apartment includes everything needed for a comfortable short or longer stay in the city centre.

Amenities for your stay:

- Basic essentials (salt, sugar, oil)
- Towels, fresh bed linen, soap, hairdryer, iron, ironing board, and drying rack
- Free Wi-Fi
- Kitchen (coffee machine, toaster, microwave, hob, cutlery, plates, kettle, etc.)
- Bathroom with bathtub and toilet
- Second bathroom with shower and toilet
- Living room with a loft with a low ceiling and additional sleeping space for up to 12 guests

Guest access
The entire apartment is exclusively for our guests and ensures complete privacy. You can fully enjoy and use all rooms during your stay.

Other things to note
All guests are required to fill out a simple online registration form and pay the city tax in accordance with Czech legislation before arrival. A link to the registration will be sent to you online.

🚭 Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the apartment, on the balcony, and in all common areas of the building. Any evidence of smoking will result in a €150 penalty fee.

Our standard working hours are from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. During this time, a €100 fee applies only in case of lost keys. After 5:00 PM, our regular working hours end. Any assistance related to keys after this time — such as lost keys, lockouts, or other access issues — will be charged €100.

In exceptional cases, we may not be able to provide immediate assistance. If a locksmith or service technician is required due to an issue caused by the guest, all related costs must be covered by the guest and are non-refundable.

📞We are available daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM. After 11:00 PM, we may not be available. We strongly recommend always ensuring you have access to the apartment when leaving and carefully reviewing the check-in instructions before arrival.

This accommodation is equipped with a “Minut Home Sensor,” which detects noise levels to help guests keep noise under control during their stay. For this purpose, we share limited information (name, phone number, and reservation details) with Minut. The Minut Sensor respects your privacy — it does not include cameras, does not record audio, and does not listen to conversations or activities. After booking, you have the right to object to the sharing of your data.

If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us. We wish you a pleasant stay in Prague!
